title: Signatures of all things I am here to read,
html_source:
The phrase derives from Jakob Bohme’s Signatura Rerum (Latin: Signature of all Things) but in context Stephen remarks his role as the perceiver of the characteristic forms of nature.

Stephen establishes the theme of transformation quickly in this chapter. Stephen turns the environment into his interpretation.

[3]



Ineluctable modality of the visible: at least that if no more, thought through my eyes.
